name: Chatbot OneMatix
author: OneMatix

sections.description:
Integrate OneMatix chatbot on your WordPress site with options for all pages, specific pages, or exclusions.

External Services

This plugin connects to the OneMatix platform in order to display the chatbot on your website.

  • Service: OneMatix Chatbot (https://onematix.ai)
  • Purpose: To embed and enable interaction with your OneMatix chatbot directly on your WordPress site.
  • Data Sent: When the chatbot is loaded, your website visitors’ interactions with the chatbot are transmitted to the OneMatix servers. No personal data is sent unless the user provides it explicitly in the chat.
  • Conditions: The chatbot will only function if you configure your Chatbot ID from the OneMatix platform.

Terms of Service: https://appchat.onematix.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://appchat.onematix.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chatbot-onematix directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Chatbot OneMatix and configure your chatbot ID and display options.
